incident_text: Heavy smoke is rising behind a farm and a house stands close to the smoke. We think a wildfire is coming toward the house.

result.scene_summary: A large plume of dark smoke rises from a forested area, with a house visible in the foreground to the right. The smoke appears to be moving from left to right across the image.

observations.description: Large, dense, dark grey smoke plume rising from the forested area on the left, with lighter, more diffuse smoke on the right.
A single house is visible in the foreground on the right, appearing undamaged but surrounded by smoke.
Dark, dense forest line on the left, with some trees visible in the foreground.
House with a gabled roof and porch, surrounded by trees and field.
Dark, heavy clouds dominate the sky, suggesting smoke and possibly weather.

inconsistencies: Report says smoke is behind a farm and a house stands close to the smoke, but image shows smoke rising from forested area and house is far from the smoke source.
not_determinable: Structural integrity of the house or farm
Speed or direction of smoke movement
Water depth or presence of water
